_description: Results page extraction schema. Each row in the results table has seller names, buyer names, address, price, date. Extracted per position (row order).
position: integer — row index in results table (0-based)
address_lines: array of strings — address from first cell, split by
note: string — transaction note from red font (e.g., 'Land Assembly', or empty)
description: string — property description from propDesc class
seller_lines: array of strings — seller entity names, one per line before 'to' divider
buyer_lines: array of strings — buyer entity names, one per line after 'to' divider
